mapping.draft_py:
# {T}, Pay 2 life, Discard a card, Sacrifice a creature: Create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with
# flying. Activate only as a sorcery.  (M21 Archfiend's Vessel's Demon; Liliana's Steward's gate)
demon = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(
        CostTap(),
        CostLife(amount=QConst(value=2)),
        CostDiscard(target=Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1), mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE, filter=FAnd(children=()),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),))),
        CostSacrifice(target=Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1), mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),))),
    )),
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Demon', type_line='Creature — Demon', types=('Creature',), subtypes=('Demon',),
            power=QConst(value=5), toughness=QConst(value=5), keywords=(Keyword.FLYING,),
            abilities=(), colors=('B',)),
    }),
    timing=ActivationWindow.SORCERY,
)
abilities = [demon, *compiled]

clauses.clause: {T}, Pay 2 life, Discard a card, Sacrifice a creature: Create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying.
clauses.evidence: Trace [activate [0] from battlefield] and its four 'ask 2' variants: 'ask sacrifice: [you_bear, you_giant]' (your creatures only), 'ask discard: [the six hand cards]', 'card becomes tapped', 'you loses 2 life' (20 -> 18), the sacrificed creature to the graveyard, the discard to the graveyard (hand 6 -> 5), '+ you:Demon (battlefield, you, 5/5, FLYING)' under the controller. Not in the trace: the token's colour. Pack A05_1 (one of each choice; the token is 5/5 flying, one only, under the controller: Corpse Knight sees it enter), A05_3/4/5 (no card, no own creature, 1 life: refused with the cost named), A05_6 (only a creature you CONTROL can be sacrificed, not one you own), A05_7 (the Demon is black: protection from black stops it blocking).

The trace activates in the controller's main phase only. Pack A05_2: on the opponent's turn the activation is refused ('window:sorcery:not_own_turn') and nothing is paid; A05_8: in the controller's own main phase with a spell on the stack it is refused too ('window:sorcery:stack_nonempty').
